title: No on-chain invariant couples BalancerPoolerV2.batchDonationSize and Hook.ratio (missing batchDonationSize + ratio <= 100 guardrail)
rootCauseClass: un-coupled cross-contract parameters (gross-debt vs net-retained backing)
scopeGuard: SURVIVING FRAMING IS THE UNLINKED-KNOBS / MISSING-ON-CHAIN-INVARIANT OPERATOR GUARDRAIL ONLY. The 'phUSD is unbacked / value can leak from the backing model' security claim is DEDUP-001 (hard-suppressed, OOS backing model per KI-1/KI-4, econ REFUTE-A: backing arithmetic unchanged from pre-story-034 baseline). It MUST NOT be re-introduced as a fresh security claim here.
description: story-034 introduced a donation->PSM-export mechanism whose safe envelope is the coupling batchDonationSize + ratio <= 100. Two owner setters in two separate contracts — BalancerPoolerV2.setBatchDonationSize (cap 100, lines 160-164) and BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.setRatio (cap 50, lines 77-82) — have no on-chain linking invariant, so the owner can silently configure batchDonationSize + ratio > 100, crossing the documented solvency-coupling boundary with no on-chain guard. Framed strictly as the operator guardrail / missing on-chain invariant.
impact: No in-protocol asset is placed at direct risk by the surviving leg. Missing on-chain invariant / non-obvious cross-contract owner footgun: a competent non-malicious owner would be surprised that two separately-capped knobs in two contracts can silently sum past the solvency boundary. The downstream backing consequence is the OOS, suppressed DEDUP-001 claim and is NOT asserted here.
attackPath: No permissionless trigger (Tier-3 invariant-confirmed). Both setters are onlyOwner.
Owner sets BalancerPoolerV2.batchDonationSize to a value and, independently, Hook.ratio to a value whose sum exceeds 100.
Nothing on-chain rejects or links the two; the configuration silently violates the batchDonationSize + ratio <= 100 guardrail.

Operational hazard realized: configuration sits outside the safe envelope until the owner manually corrects it. (Any backing/solvency consequence is the suppressed DEDUP-001 OOS claim, not classified here.)
recommendation: Add an on-chain invariant coupling the two knobs (reject any setBatchDonationSize/setRatio that would make batchDonationSize + ratio > 100), or surface the combined value through a shared validation path so the solvency boundary cannot be silently crossed.
